definition: A workflow that transforms pose-derived kinematic features into behavior classifications using supervised machine learning classifiers
assumptions: Pose estimation has already been performed on video data
Frame-level behavior annotations are available for training
Engineered features capture discriminative information for target behaviors
Train and test data share similar distributions
invariants: Features must be aligned with behavior labels at frame level
Train/test split must preserve class distributions (stratification)
Class imbalance must be addressed during training
Evaluation must use held-out test data not seen during training
non_negotiable_steps: Split data into train and test sets
Train classifier with class balance handling
deviations: None - implementation faithfully follows SimBA workflow
